title: Qwen3-30B-A3B W8A8 · Ascend 910B3

lede.zh: Qwen3-30B-A3B W8A8 在四张 Ascend 910B3 上的服务性能测试。官方 A2 配方使用 TP4、EP 与 EAGLE3；单流 TPOT 为 12.36 ms。
lede.en: Serving measurements for Qwen3-30B-A3B W8A8 on four Ascend 910B3 accelerators. The A2 recipe uses TP4, EP, and EAGLE3; single-stream TPOT is 12.36 ms.

snapshot.zh: 固定长度 · ShareGPT · 长上下文 · Agent · 开放环容量
snapshot.en: Fixed length · ShareGPT · long context · Agent · open-loop capacity

heading.zh: 同一权重内区分单流、并发与开放环结果
heading.en: Separate single-stream, concurrent, and open-loop results

intro.zh: 单流 EAGLE3 对照与其他工作负载分别呈现。并发 64 的固定输出吞吐、有限闭环吞吐与开放环 safe_rps 代表不同测量口径。
intro.en: The single-stream EAGLE3 comparison is presented separately from other workloads. Fixed-output throughput at C64, finite closed-loop throughput, and open-loop safe_rps are distinct measurement types.

note.zh: 高生成量与长上下文 P95 受到启动瞬态影响；原始全样本分位数保留为观测值，不解释为稳态尾延迟。safe_rps 的 TTFT-only 与 TTFT+TPOT 阈值分别为 2.80 和 1.86 req/s。
note.en: High-generation and long-context P95 values are affected by startup transients; full-sample percentiles are retained as observations, not steady-state tails. safe_rps is 2.80 req/s for TTFT-only and 1.86 req/s for combined TTFT+TPOT limits.

heading.zh: EAGLE3 在单流改善 TPOT；并发收益需按工作负载读取
heading.en: EAGLE3 improves single-stream TPOT; concurrent results remain workload-specific

intro.zh: 四张 Ascend 910B3，TP4 + EP + EAGLE3。固定场景在单一部署中测试；下图仅展示官方延迟场景与其单流锚点。
intro.en: Four Ascend 910B3 accelerators with TP4 + EP + EAGLE3. Fixed workloads were measured on one deployment; the chart shows the official latency profile and its single-stream point.

notes.zh: 单流对照显示 TPOT 下降 15.3%、输出吞吐增加 16.1%。这不等于所有负载都能获得同等提升。
notes.en: The single-stream comparison shows 15.3% lower TPOT and 16.1% higher output throughput. This does not imply the same gain for all workloads.

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

heading.zh: 严格延迟约束下的到达率低于只约束 TTFT 的结果
heading.en: The rate is lower when both TTFT and TPOT are constrained

intro.zh: 开放环使用 512/256 固定请求形状。其他数据包括高生成量、长上下文、ShareGPT 和 8 轮 Agent 回放。
intro.en: Open-loop traffic uses a fixed 512/256 request shape. Other measurements cover long generation, long context, ShareGPT, and an eight-turn Agent replay.

notes.zh: 所有主要固定场景为单轮测量；EAGLE3 的单流对照方向明确，但不能由此推导跨版本或跨权重的普遍收益。
notes.en: Primary fixed workloads are single-run measurements. The single-stream EAGLE3 direction is clear for this setup, but it does not establish a general gain across versions or checkpoints.

title.zh: 容量边界随 SLO 变化

hint.en: Hover a point to inspect the measurement.

zh: TTFT P95 ≤ 1 s + TPOT P95 ≤ 50 ms
en: TTFT P95 ≤ 1 s + TPOT P95 ≤ 50 ms

methodIntro: 固定负载、Agent 回放、开放环容量及 EAGLE3 A/B 使用各自明示的请求形状。报告保留启动瞬态、有限闭环与单次测量限制。
Fixed workloads, Agent replay, open-loop capacity, and EAGLE3 A/B use explicitly stated request profiles. Startup transient, finite closed-loop, and single-run limitations are retained.

methodNotes.zh: 开放环到达过程不与闭环一次性灌入的请求吞吐混为一谈。
methodNotes.en: Open-loop arrivals are not equated with request throughput from a one-shot closed-loop batch.

methodNotes.zh: EAGLE3 的接受率在受控到达率测试中保持约 30.68%–31.71%；这是该权重及草稿头设置下的结果。
methodNotes.en: EAGLE3 acceptance remained around 30.68%–31.71% in controlled arrival-rate tests; this applies to this checkpoint and draft-head setup.
